description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Review' class within the OpenCart system, specifically in the Admin Model Catalog namespace. The class manages CRUD operations and data retrieval related to product reviews, including adding, editing, deleting, and fetching reviews and their ratings.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Class representing the product review management within the OpenCart Admin Catalog module. Provides methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving reviews and their ratings.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Inserts a new review into the database, updates the related product's rating, and clears relevant cache.

methods.name: editReview
methods.description: Updates an existing review identified by review_id, recalcultes the product's rating, and refreshes cache.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Deletes a specific review by review_id and updates the product rating and cache accordingly.

methods.name: deleteReviewsByProductId
methods.description: Deletes all reviews associated with a specific product ID and clears the cache.

methods.name: getReview
methods.description: Fetches detailed data for a review specified by review_id, including associated product name.

methods.name: getRating
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average rating for a specific product, considering only approved reviews.

methods.name: getReviews
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews matching given filter criteria, with support for sorting, pagination, and filtering.

methods.name: getTotalReviews
methods.description: Returns the total number of reviews matching certain filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalReviewsAwaitingApproval
methods.description: Returns the count of reviews pending approval (status=0).
